# f-tree

> A free, open-source family tree app for Android, Windows and Linux. It works offline with no account, records relatives whose names are not known, names the relationship between any two people in English or Hindi, and merges a shared branch into a tree without overwriting anything. There is no limit on the number of people.

## Product
- [Features](https://ftree.vibethroughcode.com/features/): everything the app does
- [Download](https://ftree.vibethroughcode.com/download/): Android APK, Windows installer, Linux .deb, with checksums
- [Privacy](https://ftree.vibethroughcode.com/privacy/): what stays on the device, what can reach a network, every Android permission
- [FAQ](https://ftree.vibethroughcode.com/faq/): cost, accounts, Hindi, GEDCOM, platforms
